briefings.title: Defense Secretary, Joint Chiefs Chair & Agriculture Secretary Testify before Senate
briefings.tldr: The Trump administration is seeking an $87.6 billion supplemental funding package—as part of a broader $1.5 trillion defense goal—to sustain the ongoing conflict with Iran, replenish depleted munition stockpiles, and provide emergency relief to an agricultural sector crippled by high input costs and trade disruptions.

briefings.title: Defense Secretary and Joint Chiefs Chair Testify Before Congress
briefings.tldr: Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth and Joint Chiefs of Staff Chair Gen. Dan Caine defended a historic $1.535 trillion FY 2027 budget request before the Senate Armed Services Committee, facing intense bipartisan scrutiny over the strategic stalemate and $25 billion cost of the unauthorized war with Iran, as well as controversial purges of senior military leadership.

briefings.title: Pentagon Briefing Live | Pete Hegseth Grilled By Media As US Troops Plan Ground Invasion in Iran
briefings.tldr: Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth and General Dan Caine reported that Operation Epic Fury has struck over 11,000 Iranian targets in 30 days, achieving significant air superiority and degrading Iranian morale to the point of widespread desertion while simultaneously pursuing high-level diplomatic negotiations.
